title: CIA-UAP-016, Sightings of Unidentified Flying Objects in Ladakh, Nepal, Sikkim and Bhutan
doc_notes: This is a CIA information report detailing seven UFO sightings in the Ladakh, Nepal, Sikkim, and Bhutan regions during early 1968.

incidents.summary: Bright object seen over Chang La, Fukche, and Koyul with white light, blasting sounds, and reddish light with smoke.
incidents.location_name: Chang La, Fukche, and Koyul, Ladakh
incidents.quote: One white light and simultaneously two blasting sounds were heard.

incidents.summary: Fast-moving, long, thin object seen over Walungchung-Gola and Dhurisa, causing daylight-level brightness and thunderous sound.
incidents.quote: A fast-moving object, long and thin emitted red and risen bright, so bright as to cause daylight.

incidents.summary: Object seen over Lachung, Lachen, Thangu, Muguthang and Chholhamu, emitting light from a tail and producing thunderous sound.
incidents.location_name: Lachung, Lachen, Thangu, Muguthang and Chholhamu, Sikkim
incidents.quote: An object giving light from tail. It was bright enough to light the entire area.

incidents.summary: Object following a circular path leaving a smoke trail.
incidents.quote: Object was following a circular path. Left a trail of smoke behind it.

incidents.summary: Rocket-like object leaving a white-yellow trail at high altitude.
incidents.quote: Rocket-like object leaving white-yellow trail about 20 y long at a height of 20-25000 feet.

incidents.summary: Bluish colored object moving at high speed without noise, bright enough to illuminate the area.
incidents.quote: A bluish colored object moving at high speed without any noise.

incidents.summary: Blazing object flashing intermittently, accompanied by thunder sound, disintegrated over the region.
incidents.quote: A blazing object, flashing intermittently, accompanied by thunder sound disintegrated over Kuki region.

incidents.summary: Metallic disc-shaped object found in a crater.
incidents.quote: A huge metallic disc-shaped object with a six-foot base and two feet in height was found in a crater
